summary: Frontend E2E + Backend smoke testing of Driver Delivery/Transport flow and Passenger tracking pages. All flows passed end-to-end on https://gojek-clone-40.preview.emergentagent.com.
critical_code_review_comments: DeliveryJobsPage.js: refresh polled only on action — for live updates without manual refresh, consider polling interval (already done on tracking page with 8s interval). Acceptable for driver use.
DeliveryTrackingPage.js: silently swallows fetch errors (catch ignores); consider showing a transient error toast for non-404 errors. Non-blocking.

Backend medical/transport accepts only dest_lat/dest_lng (not destination_lat/destination_lng). Frontend MedicalTransportPage submits dest_lat (correct). Confirm naming is consistent across all callers to avoid 400 'Lieu de départ et destination requis'.
Both pages have all required data-testid attributes — testing fully reliable.
test_credentials: Driver jean.dupont@demo.sb / Driver123! — works. Passenger rider.qa@demo.sb / Rider123! — works.
seed_data_creation: Created parcel parcel_a1cef7517305 (multi, 2 stops, 6.01€) and medtr_7459b0788ab1 (Ambulance Standard, 54€) via API as rider.qa@demo.sb. Both completed during the test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Driver/passenger delivery & medical transport flow fully functional. Driver: /chauffeur/livraisons → tab-available lists avail-parcel-<id>/avail-transport-<id>; accept-* moves to tab-active; parcel-advance-* steps accepted→arrived_pickup→picked_up (then parcel-legs-<id> shows deliver-leg-<id>-0/1, marking all delivered closes the mission with toast 'Toutes les livraisons effectuées !'). Transport advance: accepted→en_route_pickup→patient_onboard→arrived→completed (toast 'Course terminée'). Passenger tracking /track/parcel/<id> and /track/transport/<id> shows tracking-timeline with all step-* nodes reflecting current status; tracking-legs lists per-stop status. Polling every 8s on tracking page works.

passenger_tracking.parcel_page: /track/parcel/<id> → delivery-tracking-page; tracking-timeline with step-accepted, step-arrived_pickup, step-picked_up, step-in_transit, step-completed all rendered; tracking-legs shows Dépôt 1 · Alice ✓ Livré and Dépôt 2 · Bob ✓ Livré
passenger_tracking.transport_page: /track/transport/<id> → all 5 medical steps rendered; final status 'Course terminée' active
